subject: Nuevo Foundation: Spring coding clubs, student spotlights, and how to help
preheader: See what our students built this season and join us at the spring showcase.
title: Nuevo Foundation Community Newsletter
intro: Thank you for being part of the Nuevo Foundation community. This season our volunteers ran coding clubs at eleven schools and welcomed more than 300 students to their first line of code.

stories.heading: Students built their first games
stories.body: Fourth and fifth graders at Lincoln Elementary spent six weeks learning loops and conditionals, and finished the club by publishing a game they designed themselves.

stories.heading: Volunteers wanted for the fall season
stories.body: No teaching experience is required. We provide the curriculum, the training, and a partner volunteer for every classroom.
